agent_explanation: Controller at saturated fmax drives body leftward at ~9.4 m/s into the top corner of thin vertical wall (x=6.235,w=0.346,top y~6.82; body y~7.0,r=0.77). Grazing corner contact with only 2 substeps: impulse plus positional correction fails to push the circle out, so signed distance degrades from +0.327 at step 340 to -0.063 at step 350 to -0.138 at step 352 to -0.175 at step 353, accumulating penetration past the 0.15 limit while controller keeps pushing into the wall.
